messages:
maria_support: Pinned a customer escalation — ACME (on behalf) reports monthly credits seem to have only partially refilled after a plan upgrade. Their add-on top-up showed up but the base monthly bucket stayed at 0, and they hit 429s in production during a demo. Can someone triage? thread_ts=1768887654

alex_eng: Got it. Can you paste tenant/org id + a minimal repro (curl) and the exact 429 response headers?

maria_support: Tenant: acme-prod (id: org_53421). Customer ran this curl at 03:45 UTC after upgrading at 03:40: 
```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" -H "X-Org-ID: org_53421" https://api.redwood.dev/v1/complete -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```
Response snippet: 
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
x-credits-remaining: 0
x-credits-window-reset: 1700000000
content-type: application/json
{"error":"quota_exhausted"}
They say ledger shows monthly refill at 00:00 UTC, and add-on credit at 03:40 is visible. Customer impact: production demo failing.

eng-ops: Thanks. Two quick checks: (1) Is the API key attached to the org-level bucket or a legacy service key? (2) I'll check edge cache records for org_53421 and the billing-sync logs around 03:40–04:00.

billing-team: I pulled the ledger for org_53421. There is a normal monthly refill event at 00:00 UTC: refill_id=rf_2026_03_01_0000 amount=120000 tokens. Then at 03:40 there is a plan-change adjustment: adj_id=pa_98765 which credited the add-on (topup_id=top_555) but also triggered a reallocation job that wrote an interim negative adjustment to the base bucket (reason: legacy proration path). Evidence: a job run at 03:41 produced a credit_delta = -120000 but should have been a metadata move. It looks like a race between the refill writer and the proration reconciler.

jordan_support: For mitigation, we can either (A) apply a temporary top-up so customer can continue running the demo, or (B) tell them to rotate to the new API key that was issued during the upgrade. Which do we prefer? Also, can eng-ops post the edge cache keys so we can invalidate.

eng-ops: Edge logs: cache key = "quota:org:org_53421:monthly" last updated 2026-03-01T03:41:12Z with value=0 and ttl ~ 12h. It was a cache write from billing-sync v1.2.3 at 03:41. I suspect the refill happened but then the proration reconciliation overwrote the cached value. I'll invalidate that key and trigger an immediate sync from ledger -> edge.

deploy-bot: billing-sync v1.2.4 canary deployed to prod at 1768888040 by eng-runtime (note: v1.2.3 still serving 80% traffic).

eng-runtime: We are rolling a fix to ensure proration writes are additive, not destructive. For immediate relief, eng-ops please run a ledger->cache resync for org_53421 and billing-team please record a corrective adjustment if needed. I can also push a temporary patch to the sync job to prefer ledger sums over delta writes.

billing-team: Created corrective adjustment: corr_adj_id=cor_444 amount=+120000 tokens applied at 1768888250. Also created temporary top-up top_temp_999 for 200k tokens. Marked as support mitigation.

eng-ops: Invalidated cache key and ran sync job. Post-sync read: monthly_bucket=120000, add_on_topup=top_555 (visible), total_available=320000.

maria_support: Updated ACME (on behalf) — we applied a corrective adjustment and invalidated caches. Asking them to retry and confirm.

maria_support (relay): ACME says they retried the same curl and now get HTTP/1.1 200 and x-credits-remaining: 319980 — main service OK. They also asked for root-cause summary and ETA for permanent fix.

eng-runtime: Root cause: a legacy proration reconcilier path (billing-sync v1.2.3) ran after the midnight refill and wrote a negative delta to the cached monthly bucket for certain upgrade flows; this race caused visible 0 in the edge cache and subsequent 429s even though ledger had the refill. Fix: patch proration path to use atomic ledger snapshot writes and deploy v1.2.4 to all nodes. ETA for full rollout: ~30m.

maria_support: Thanks team — ACME confirmed demo completed successfully. I'll close the escalation once eng-runtime confirms rollout finished and billing records an internal postmortem.

billing-team: Noted — will open a postmortem ticket PM-789 and tag proration owner.

eng-runtime: Full rollout complete at 1768888550. PR #3421 merged. Will follow up in postmortem with repro and test coverage.

maria_support: Closing loop with customer. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
